------TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNTS
INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASKS]
(
	[TASK_NAME]	,
	[DATA_LAYER]	,
	[SCHEMA_NAME]	,
	[TABLE_NAME]	,
	[SOURCE_CODE]	,
	[DESCRIPTION]	,
	[UPDATE_DATETIME]	,
	[CREATE_DATETIME]	
)
SELECT 
	'TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNTS' TASK_NAME,
	'EDS_STG' DATA_LAYER,
	'D360' SCHEMA_NAME,
	'CRM_ACCOUNTS' TABLE_NAME,
	'CRM' SOURCE_CODE,
	NULL DESCRIPTION,
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) UPDATE_DATETIME,
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) CREATE_DATETIME
